description: Session context and the compaction summary's instructions, the Bash call check, Markdown formatting and record note checks after an edit, the tasks a bd close made ready, the prompt time, and a rewrite of a reply that names a task ID without its title, for the record repository at KARO_HOME (default ~/karo).

hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" != "${KARO_HOME:-$HOME/karo}" ] || [ ! -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.beads" ] || { cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; echo '## bd: in_progress'; bd list --status in_progress --limit 0 --json | jq -r '.[]? | [.id, .status, (.assignee // "-"), ((.labels // []) | map(select(startswith("project:"))) | join(",")), .title] | @tsv'; echo '## bd: 判断待ち'; bd human list --status open; echo '## bd: ready'; bd ready --exclude-type decision --limit 10 --json | jq -r '.[]? | [.id, .priority, ((.labels // []) | map(select(startswith("project:"))) | join(",")), .title] | @tsv'; echo '## bd: 件数'; bd count --by-status; }
